title: Safekeys Capability Token v1 — Claims Set
description: The JWS payload (claims set) of a Safekeys capability token. A token is carried as safekey://v1/<sid>#<JWS> where <JWS> is an RFC 7515 compact JWS whose payload validates against this schema. This schema validates the DECODED claims set, not the compact serialisation. INVARIANT: no field may carry plaintext, an unwrapped data encryption key (DEK), or a key-encryption key (KEK). additionalProperties is false so a field cannot be smuggled in.

iss.description: Issuer — the control plane that minted the token. Used to resolve the verification key set. MUST be https.

sub.description: Subject — the principal the token was issued to (e.g. an agent identity or operator). Optional but strongly recommended for attribution; when absent, the audit record's requester is the sidecar's local peer identity.

sid.description: Secret or folder object identifier. MUST match the <sid> in the URI path — a mismatch is a verification failure.

scope.description: Granted operations, enforced as least privilege. Issuers SHOULD emit the smallest set that satisfies the request; a resolver MUST deny any operation not present. Over-broad sets are a policy failure, not a format feature.

aud.description: Audience — the intended resolver identity or environment. A resolver MUST reject a token whose aud does not match its own identity. Binds authority to one environment so a staging token cannot be used in production.

exp.description: Expiry — NumericDate (seconds since Unix epoch). Resolvers MUST reject once the current time is past exp. TTLs are minutes to hours, never days.

nbf.description: Not before — NumericDate (seconds since Unix epoch). A resolver MUST reject before this time. MUST be less than or equal to exp.

jti.description: Unique token identifier for replay control and revocation. MUST be recorded at mint time so it can be denylisted. MUST be unique across all tokens ever issued by an issuer.

$comment: Header constraints are NOT expressible in this schema and MUST be enforced by the verifier: alg MUST be in the allowlist ['EdDSA','ES256']; alg 'none', 'HS256', 'HS384', 'HS512' and any symmetric algorithm MUST be rejected; kid MUST be present and resolve to a known verification key; typ MUST be 'safekey-token+jws' when present. See README.md and v1.vectors.json.
